nom: Perricone MD High Potency Face Finishing & Firming Tinted Moisturizer SPF 30

avis.texte: I got sucked into buying this by an overzealous sales clerk. The sample on my hand seemed ok but the next day I tried it at home and yuck. I put a very thin layer on and not only does it have a very strong, grandmaish, rose smell (on your face, near your nose where you would smell it all day) but it just sat on my skin and made my face sticky and oily. Even after multiple hours, it never felt different. If thats what you need, awesome, but its not for me and will be returning it tomorrow.

I love this moisturizer. I love how it feels on my skin. Keeps my skin moisturized all day. I love the tint. I haven't used foundation since starting to use this moisturizer. It's not greasy or sticky.
I am in love with this product. I can wear this and forego the heavy foundation and still look great!

This is my everyday go-to moisturizer! I don't even reach for foundation anymore. This works great to even out my redness just enough without looking like makeup. It hydrates all day, adds a healthy glow (not greasy) and gives a subtle plumpness and makes my face feel a little tighter and smoother. If you want a little coverage without the heaviness, AND SPF...this is it!
Have used product for years. After pandemic, shade/color has not returned to original.
Light weight, light coverage that makes my skin glow. Skin looks sun-kissed.
I like this product. Perfect for days that you have little time for makeup.

I've been using this product for a year plus and I personally absolutely love it… adds a hint of color so on weekends, I can put it on without foundation and during the week I will put it on under my foundation!!

I love that this product comes in a glass container. It has good smooth texture and looks great on my skin. I have very sensitive skin so this was making me break out, however it's does really well on my husband. It's a very light tint so even he didn't notice. It's a pricey product but if you don't have sensitive skin I would get it.

Love love love the product. The tint matches my shade well, but don't think it is a universal shade AT ALL, definitely a light yellow undertone tint. The product is hydrating and has SPF which is what I was lookin for, but it's (in my opinion) a little expensive for how much you get.

I have been using this tinted moisturizer for over 5 years and i love it. It gives me a great glow, protects my skin from the sun and it helps with fine lines and wrinkles. I will be using it forever.
I love this product. It is so smooth and just a little tint. I can wear it and not even put on make up. It also has sod so that's a plus
I love the results of this product. It evens out skin tones and has a little tint to cover blemishes. I love that it has spf also.
Best tinted sunscreen I have ever used. So moist with great coverage. Only thing I wear!

I really didn't notice a difference using this product. If you have sensitive skin then definitely patch test it did cause some irritation sometimes. It does has SPF but unsure if that may be what's causing the sensitivity and irritation.

avis.titre: Goes on smooth and leave my skin protected and looking good
avis.texte: I use this as my everyday face sunscreen and I love it. it goes on perfectly, leaves no weird cast, and makes my skin look finished. I have not noticed any "firming" benefits, but I didn't really expect to do so. It is definitely not sweat proof. I would recommend this to anyone who is looking for a very slightly tinted moisturizer with good sun protection.
Just the right amount of tint paired with perfectly balanced moisturizer.
No makeup lines. At 70 I want just a bit of color and coverage. This has it all.
This moisturizer sunscreen had a nice sheer look and was easy to apply, but after about an hour my skin looked sunburnt and blotchy. Unimpressed for such a moisturizer given the price.

A sales associate recommend this to me. I have had multiple comments on my skin that it is radient since I started using this. I will buy again. I an very happy with the glow this gives me. Tint is not a lot of color, it is a perfect natural no makeup glowy look.
I have used this for years. Glad to see it on sale for the spring and summer sunny months! I like it.

avis.titre: Could not get over the strong smell!
avis.texte: I had to remove it soon after putting it on because the scent was so overwhelming, and it was not a pleasant one. I wish I had seen that it was fragranced or I wouldn't have ordered it because I don't put scented products on my face as it is. I can't really speak to the quality of the product otherwise since I didn't leave it on long enough to know.

I just bought my second container — as someone with very dry skin, this gives the perfect light coverage with a little tint and leaves me moisturized. People are constantly are telling me that im glowing! Well worth the price.
This cream feels nice and applies smoothly. However, it turns my skin a very funky color. I usually like Perricone MD products, but this one was a waste of my money.

I am 58 and have been using this tinted moisturizer for many years. I absolutely love it. I apply a serum and this on top, a little cream blush or bronzer and I am set for the day. I receive compliments on my complexion often and i swear it is because of this amazing moisturizer. I stock up as i never want to be without it. Amazing!
I'm obsessed with Perricone MD products. This moistuizer is no exception. The tint isn't obvious. I love the SPF. That is very important. My skin looks firm and feels great!
This cream absolutely smells amazing. I love that the tint is super light so it doesn't feel like you are wearing makeup. It keeps my face so moist throughout the day. I keep going back to using this

I absolutely love this moisturizer. I started using it years ago and will never switch! I have very sensitive skin and this never causes me any issues. A little goes a long way. Despite using this daily, I find that it lasts me several months. I'm not a person that uses makeup and the tint in this is perfect. It's really smooth and hydrating, leaving my skin looking glowy and fresh. It helps even out my skin, absorbs well, protects, and doesn't look "fake" or like makeup. Would recommend to anyone!

I love this product! I have never tried a tented moisturizer but this one is definitely lovely. It smells absolutely divine and leaves my skin looking wonderful. I don't feel like I even need makeup when I'm using this. It leaves your skin feeling refreshed and protected as well. The packaging is simple but elegant too. Your skin will definitely thank you for using this product.

avis.titre: A no makeup girlie must have! ❤️
avis.texte: This is my new favorite moisturizer! As a no makeup girlie who loves looking natural and glowy this has elevated my skin game to a whole new level. My skin looks hydrated and luminous without feeling greasy. I appreciate that it blends effortlessly into my skin without any streaking or looking orange like so many other tinted moisturizers that I have tried. I can wear this all day and it's a bonus that it contains 30 SPF so I can save time in my skincare routine when I'm getting ready in the morning.
Touted as a no makeup look product I did not think it provided good enough coverage to wear alone. I do think it's an easy product to use and it goes on well. I am using it as a moisturizer.

This tinted moisturizer is a great low maintenance low makeup but glowy skin option. It doesn't have any major coverage but does help even out my complexion. The SPF in it isn't enough to actually protect so make sure you're using one as well and don't demand on just this for spf protection.

I love how this product applies, absorbs and makes my skin feel. I feel there is a fresher and brighter look to o my skin when using this. Also love that it has SPF so is great for daily use. I can't attest to the long term benefits after years of use because I haven't used that long, but so far it's been great!

I love using this tinted moisturizer for every day wear. It gives my fair skin some color and makes it look healthier looking. It is perfect for no makeup days. I love that it contains SPF as well. The formula is light and it absorbs nicely into my skin .
I love the way this makes my feel and look. It keeps me moisturized all day. I layer on top of my skin serums and it keeps everything locked in. The tint doesn't make a big difference.

My skin feels so hydrated and refreshed without caking on makeup. It really does smooth out my skin tone cuz I have light age/sun spots all over my face and it looks more even after application. It doesn't have that nasty chemical smell which I appreciate and I like knowing it has SPF in it because I live in Florida and it's a must for someone with white skin like me. I also love that it's not a heavy feeling on the face.
Love this moisturizer. It's a lightweight moisturizer with SPF. Smells like rose water instead of sunscreen. Feels great on skin and doesn't leave a white cast. Would 100% recommend for daily wear.
It smells overwhelming like rose! I can't stand it. It made me look like I had fake tanner on and cheap rose soap. I washed it off immediately. It goes on easy but I hate the smell and tint
I like this tinted moisturizer, I wear it by itself and it makes my skin look great. It blends well and lasts all day. I would recommended if you're looking for a tinted moisturizer

I received this product complementary from Influenster for my honest review. This cream is very hydrating, leaving your skin feeling very luscious. The tint is very light, to the point I wasn't sure if it had any.

This was soft & gentle on my sensitive skin and felt pretty moisturizing. Not my favorite but also not a bad choice at all! Unscented and love that it has sun protection. Doesn't seem to last as long as I'd prefer but overall a good product - no pilling; nice glass jar.

avis.titre: I like it, but wish it matched my skin tine more.
avis.texte: I received this product free for my honest opinion. I am not sure if I like it or not. It definitely feels good on my skin but can seem a little "muddy". I like that it gives some color, however it is a little hard to blend with the rest of my skin. This wiuld be beautiful on someone less pale than I am.

This is a nice moisturizer with a glowy finish. I have fair skin and the tint is non existent. I have tried several times and methods and have not seen any tint. In order to get the spf effect you would have to use a huge amount of product. I'm not sure that I would purchase this product

I received the Perricone MD High Potency Face Finishing and Firming Tinted Moisturizer Broad Spectrum SPF 30 free from Influenster in exchange for my honest review. I have used Perricone MD, but I have not seen this product before. The tinted moisturizer is amazing. It has a thicker texture, but still very rich and creamy. The coverage is superb and it blends in flawlessly without any noticeable difference whatsoever. It give you a tinted look without any shine. This to me is the best product I've ever used. The fact that it also firms your face is just an added bonus. The coverage and SPF is real kicker. Trying to find a light coverage in the summer that doesn't clog your pores and you still look like you are wearing makeup and you have SPF. This is it. And it is a moisturizer, but wait, it also tightens your skin. Hands down the best! Love it. If you haven't tried it, go try it. Thank me later. This is now on my must have list.

At almost 68 I have always been a full coverage foundation gal …. Until now. This tinted moisturizer evens out my skin tone and also leaves a glow to my skin. It has a lightweight texture even though it contains a broad spectrum SPF30 sunscreen. I also showed on my hand how it evened out my veins & sun damage. It took a lot for me to post a pic of myself so that should tell you how confident it made me feel !

Loving the slight glow this Perricone firming tinted moisturizer gives me. It's just enough day or night. The spf 30 is just what I needed. After having several skin cancers on my face this is just what my Dermatologist recommended. Slight scent, non irritating and last all day. A quick baby wipe and it can easily be removed if needed.

pros- love that it's tinted, makes my skin appear younger which I love, makes me feel moisturized, lasts a while, love that it is SPF 30 (huge for living in the south), great absorption, like that the dark packaging is conducive for keeping the product quality cons- kind of stronger smell, expensive (but worth it), many inactive ingredients including fragrance (which I don't think is necessary in a high end moisturizer)

Hydrating and glowy, great for my dry winter skin. Wish it had more of a golden glow but otherwise seemed to smooth my skin after a couple weeks of use and was a nice base for makeup. Had a soft, rose scent. Received in exchange for my honest review.

I love the lightweight, luxurious scent and fast-absorbing texture of Perricone MD moisturizer. My skin is brighter and my acne dark spot, red patches have faded significantly after 2 weeks. The ingredients are clearly listed with high-end pearl pigment microcapsules that seem to breathe new life and give my skin a natural radiance. I will consistently use it and repurchase it to keep my skin moisturized and reduce the appearance of eye wrinkles because the results are so noticeable.

avis.titre: Tinted SPF protection that moisturizes and leaves your sk...
avis.texte: I absolutely love the Perricone MD High Potency Face Finishing & Firming Tinted Moisturizer with Broad Spectrum SPF 30. In the past I have tried just about every tinted moisturizer under the sun and finally I have found one that Is moisturizing, has a great scent, lasts all day, and blends in for a flawless natural beauty look. This tinted moisturizer does not settle into your fine lines; large pores, or leaves creases by the end of the day. It actually gives you a beautiful natural sun kissed glow and leaves your skin feeling better than it did when you started. To top it off it even helps repair your skin and reduce the appearance of fine lines over time. I feel like I am able to skip the heavy foundation and just use the Perricone MD tinted moisturizer and feel great all day and more confident in my skin. From day 1 my skin looked so beautiful, no irritation and I tend to have a more sensitive skin. I absolutely love the glow and the SPF protection!

avis.titre: A perfect glowing finish with SPF 30👍
avis.texte: I'm so impressed with this product. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly without any pilling or breakouts. My skin looks more even, radiant and firmer thanks to the great hydration. I especially love subtle, signature rose scents. It's very relaxing. It's the perfect all-in-one for skincare, sheer coverage and SPF 30 protection.

If I could give this tinted moisturizer 10 stars then I would! I absolutely love how it makes my skin look instantly healthier and radiant without feeling heavy. I was very surprised that the product appears kind of off white without any visible pigment, BUT after application my skin looks like I've spent an entire day at an upscale spa. It immediately gives your skin a radiant, almost sun-kissed glow. I've stopped wearing foundation anymore because I don't need it with this tinted moisturizer. The formula is lightweight and ultra hydrating, plus it also has SPF, all in one product. This is hands down the best skincare product I've tried in the past year!

Loving this Perricone MD tinted firming moisturizer. Light clean scent packaged in a heavy glass jar. It gives a natural radiant finish without feeling heavy or greasy and the tint evens everything out in seconds. I love that it has SPF 30 built in so I am getting sun protection while my skin looks smooth and healthy. It feels lightweight blends easily and gives a subtle firming effect that makes my skin look fresh and lifted perfect for no makeup days. When you still wanna look put together.

I've been using the Perricone MD Face Finishing and Firming Tinted Moisturizer for about a month now, and overall I've really enjoyed it. The dewy finish is beautiful and leaves my skin a healthy glow and leaves me face feeling smooth and hydrated throughout the day. The tint is light and natural. I personally have loved just a touch of more coverage. It's perfect for a minimal, everyday makeup look. As far as firming goes, I have noticed much visible firming yet. That said, I continue to enjoy the way it makes my skin look and feel. It has a light scent that initially surprised me but it actually grew on me over time. I also really appreciate that it has SPF, it makes it an easy grab and go option for daytime use. Overall, it's a great choice if you love radiant finish, and light breathable coverage with the added bonus of sun protection.

Absolutely love this, you don't know when you see something as tinted how it's going to look on your skin and it blends in so perfectly. You can tell the difference on one side of the face to the other of which has a tinted moisturizer and it feels so soft and last all day long. Perfect for the Florida sun.

This Perricone tinted moisturizer is not very moisturizing. I found myself having to put reapply moisturizer later in the day. The white cast upon initial application is off putting but it goes away quickly.

avis.titre: Whipped texture and a natural finish
avis.texte: I received this to try and overall I am happy with this High Potency Face & Firming Tinted Moisturizer with SPF 30. The texture is whipped, and it blends easily into the skin. The tint is sheer but subtle, and evens everything out without feeling like foundation. It's perfect for minimal makeup days. The SPF 30 is a win and therefore can wear only this for errand days. There is a noticeable light scent that dissipates shortly after application. I haven't seen a dramatic forming effect yet but it typically takes 60-90 days to see the full effects of a new product. For now it is a solid everyday option.

I've consistently had great experiences with Perricone products, so my expectations were already high - and this one absolutely delivered! Don't let the texture and color in the jar fool you. It looks a bit like whipped cinnamon butter at first first glance, but once applied, it smooths into skin with a subtle slightly tanned tint. The finish is smooth and hydrating. I have dry skin, so I preferred wearing this as a top layer over my daily moisturizer. It could easily be used as a standalone moisturizer for normal and oily girlies. It also has a pleasant scent but isn't overpowering. I've enjoyed using this for "no-makeup" days. I love that it combines SPF with a touch of color coverage, not too cool and not too warm. I received this product for free from Influenster and Perricone in exchange for my honest review.

5/5 great tinted moisturizer. I was able to use it with the serum and it works great. My skins which is always dry looks moisturized and healthy. Use it daily and have a great results. Works great for my sensitive skin as well.

avis.titre: Mineral sunscreen and moisturizer in one
avis.texte: I imagine this would be a great product for skin tones lighter than mine. It was hydrating and firmed my skin. Since it's a mineral based sunscreen when I put it on, it did have a white cast sheen on my face which is not an option for me unfortunately. I did like that it had a nice floral scent. I think it also a great option for those with oily skin tones deeper than wear under foundation.

I received this as an incentive for an honest review. I absolutely love this. The first thing I noticed putting this on is that it blurred my skin. Then I noticed it tinting after it warmed up on my face. This has a natural scent and has no smell of sunblock. It literally feels like skin care and just looks so beautiful on the skin. This is one of my favorite ones I've ever tried. You can wear alone or under makeup. It's easy to remove and so light weight, I don't even feel it on the skin. This is absolutely worth the money, and I will be splurging on this. Never had a problem with breakouts or clogged pores. Definitely recommend.

I can see myself using this product a lot in the summer, on the days where I do not want to wear any makeup. I have a medium complexion and I personally did not feel like this produced any sort of pigmentation on my skin, so it may be better for lighter skin tones. Also, if you are someone who does not like fragranced skin care, stay away, because this one is a bit strong.

I like the moisture level a lot, it is very hydrating for dry skin in the winter. However, the tint is very Orange toned, which I do not like. The color accentuates texture or lines and ends up looking quite patchy. I was hoping to use it alone with no additional makeup on top but that isn't possible.

I really love the whipped texture of the cream. A little goes a long way. It blends in smoothly and dries down a little tacky, then absorbs into my skin within 10 minutes. I don't see much of a tint, but I'm ok. I need more time to rate the firming quality. I have high hopes. Petite bottle that I feel will last a while. My skin has retained moisture longer using this cream in my routine.

The Perricone MD Firming Tinted Moisturizer helps me have SPF as part of my daily routine. I admit I'm bad at remembering to apply sunscreen, the main reason as it tends to cause me to breakout. This moisturizer isn't overly heavy and the light color is appreciated especially when some SPF can give a weird cast to the skin. I like it!

I was able to try Perricone MD high potency face finishing and firming tinted moisturizer. I love! Love! Love! this product! It leaves my skin soft, hydrated, glowing and spf protected! It has almost a texture to it, likely the mineral based spf. It is slightly tinted so you can see exactly where it goes. You almost have a dewy finish. Highly recommend!

It's very hydrating and smooth. It feels great on the skin. The tint is very subtle, and would not give you any coverage, it probably is just there to mask the white of the sunscreen. Overall I like it. I'd love it if it didn't have such a strong cologne fragrance.

This is a very nice feeling cream. I'm super pale so the tinting on me looks like a bronzer. So if you love bronzer this is a great all in one. I personally don't use bronzer or really like how it looks on me. I do really love how luxurious and whipped the texture is though. The tint also stays on and won't wipe off with just water. You'll need to use a cleanser or makeup remover.

This facial moisturizer is magical. When you look at it at first, it looks like a normal facial cream but the moment you apply it to your face, it transforms into a tinted facial cream! No need to use foundation when you use this product. On the plus side, it leaves my skin really smooth and the cream is absorbed quite fast. In the negative side, I found the tint a little dark for my skin so I think it is a product I would use in the warmer months rather than in winter when my skin is naturally quite pale. Bonus: there is a SPF.

This High Potency Face Finishing & Firming Tinted Moisturizer is great! I have been using it for days and with the added SPF 30 it has become an essential for everyday use. The coverage is very slight. A little goes a long way. It's a whipped feeling texture and I love how it feels on my skin. Thank you Influenster and Perricone MD for letting me try this for my honest review.

avis.titre: Amazing for dry uneven skin tone
avis.texte: This is the best thing that's happened to my skin in months! As I'm sure many people have, I've been experiencing incredibly dry flaky skin due to the wind and cold. This tinted moisturizer has magic in it because after applying, it sort of melts into my skin, creating this beautiful, "my skin, but not blotchy" canvas. Lately I'm not wearing much more than this and some concealer. I don't have to fuss..it lasts, and doesn't feel greasy or heavy. I'm off to Florida this coming week, and I love that this product is not only a fabulous tinted moisturizer, but also contains SPF30! Gorgeous, and I will re-buy!

I love the modern clean packaging this item comes in. It is a great size and the product itself is great consistency . Love the spf in it and it wears really well on my skin without being heavy . Nice natural looking finish on the skin. I did receive the product for free in exchange for my honest opinion.
Gives your face a subtle glow. I don't have to use foundation.

avis.titre: Hydrating, moisturizing and doesn't leave your skin feeli...
avis.texte: I love it! Very hydrating, moisturizing and doesn't leave your skin feeling greasy. There is a slight cast, so I'm not really sure what color is supposed to be but it's nothing to worry about because the way it blends into the skin, It can still be worn under makeup. The scent is pleasant. It's not strong at all, very subtle. I have sensitive skin and I haven't noticed any breakouts from the product yet. I recommend.

avis.titre: Really great just didn't love the strong smell
avis.texte: This is such a great product! In terms of moisturizing, it's awesome. You look really hydrated and gives such a nice glow. The tinted aspect is nice also and I feel like the hydration lasted all day. The only negative for me was the scent. It was really strong and perfume-y and was overwhelming in my opinion. But was happy with the hydration and the SPF!

This moisturizer is like triple duty. I love that it is moisturizing, spf and tinted. I can not speak to the firming but I did notice a more luminous finish. It does a great job of adjusting to your tone. I'm very fair and it makes me look more even and bright. The texture is like a whipped mouse which I did not expect but love. The smell is a little on the rose side which I didn't love but got used to. The moisture lasts all day and the tint holds up well too.

I want to start off by saying that I only took one star away because this moisturizer smells like old lady. I wish it were unscented. Other than the smell, it makes my skin feel incredibly soft and it does not cause me to breakout. The tint is barely there, so the shade was okay. It helps conceal some of the natural redness in my face. I will keep using it, but I won't be repurchasing.
This is lightweight effective coverage for tinted moisturizer. Provides good sun coverage when using retinol products. Subtle scent not irritating and removes easily

The texture just blends into the skin. It feels soft and delicate on my face. There are no harsh scents. I love how it fits perfectly on the vanity. It's a perfect day cream that doesn't feel overpowering. It blends perfectly and doesn't sit on my skin.

This comes nicely packaged, with a booklet and a protective inner seal. Has a subtle clean scent. Broad spectrum SPF plus a moisturizer plus has a tint! Blends in smoothly and even! A little goes a long way! Promotes face finishing and firming! Love it so far, looking forward to seeing the extended use results!

I love Perricone MD, they are up in my top 3 favorite skincare brands. The High Potency Face Finishing & Firming Tinted Moisturizer provides a mineral based broad spectrum SPF 30, lightweight hydration that will leave you with a pearlescent glow. It immediately restores moisture and over time, with consistent use it helps soften fine lines, pores appear smaller and skin feels plump. You can wear it alone for a dewy glow or under foundation to step it up a notch. It's non-irritating and has little to no scent. The texture is very light and creamy, it melts into the skin. All the benefits of ALA and Bisabolol, plus it's oil-free!

I really love this tinted moisturizer from Perricone! It's nice and lightweight, which is one of the most important things I look for in a daytime moisturizer. It already has SPF added, so it's another bonus of eliminating another step for the day. Third, I actually enjoy the tint it provided. From my picture, you can slightly see the difference in the left and right sides of my hand. It will also give you that dewy look if you wear it alone. This will be my go-to moisturizer this spring and summer, especially when I'm wearing less makeup in the heat!
This is a great moisturizer and hydrating. It's not sticky or tacky and absorbs wonderfully. The tint is just a wonderful healthy glow for those no makeup days. It's also nice under foundation.

avis.titre: This one missed the mark for me
avis.texte: This, in my opinion, should be marketed soley as an SPF 30 moisturizer and not as a tinted moisturizer. The tint doesn't actually come from color but rather pearlescent microcapsules for a 'natural looking glow'. I feel calling it a tinted moisturizer is somewhat misleading. It feels wonderful on the skin, is very hydrating, and does not feel sticky or tacky. It also plays nice with my makeup. But I still need makeup after use, as after application on my pale, pink-tinted porcelain skin the product provides no additional color payoff. The glass jar packaging is lovely but at this price-point an applicator or spatula should be included to prevent cross-contamination.

My favorite moisturizer ever! I buy again and again because it gives me the perfect tinted complexion while keeping my skin hydrated. Also has SPF as a bonus! It is slightly greasy but nothing a great primer can't resolve!

I liked this moisturizer. It gave my skin a very healthy glow and made my skin have than clean glowy look. It lasted through the day & was easy to use and apply. Its a thick consistency like a cream, but goes on well and a little goes a long way. It helps with firming and moisture, although I would've liked a little more 'coverage' and evening out on skin tone. It matched well to give just a subtle tint.

This tinted moisturizer felt so airy and hydrating on the skin. Blended so well that it gave me a glow. The coverage is perfect and the shade matched my skin tone even though it's hard to find my right shade.

This product is amazing for everyday use! It's super light and airy but definitely provides a healthy looking tint, especially if you live somewhere where the sun isn't out in the winter. I love that it makes me feel like I got some sunshine even when I haven't. The only reason I didn't give this product 5 stars is I'm not a huge fan of the scent. It's a bit "perfumey" for my taste, but that aside it's my new daily go to!

I received this product complimentary from Perricone MD and Influencer in exchange for my honest review. Incredibly soft, light and smooth in texture, it is truly a lovely moisturizer and sunscreen that comes beautifully packaged. There is a gorgeous pearlescent glow to the skin when you put it on and a small amount goes a long way, it made my skin feel soft and hydrated without being overly emollient. I am generally not a fan of fragrance in my skincare but I did really like the very subtle, soft hint of rose it gives, very feminine. I love that it is a mineral sunscreen, perfect for my sensitive skin. The only issue for me with this product was that I am incredibly fair skinned and the tint turned quite orange on me after applying. It would be perfect for me if it had remained the initial pearlescent color it was when I first applied. It's lovely, I would highly recommend it for others who are not so fair skinned.

Most tinted moisturizer i feel are not moisturizing enough, but perricone made sure skin care is still their main priority when they made this. It looks light in the jar, but once applied to the face, the pigment slowly comes forth until it provide a sheer warmth coverage. Perfect no makeup look.

I received the Perricone MD High Potency Face Finishing & Firming Tinted Moisturizer Broad Spectrum SPF 30 in exchange for my honest review. This moisturizer was lightweight, and fast absorbing! Initially I tried the moisturizer on only half of my face, and instantly I can tell which side of my face I put the product on! The formula is pearlescent, it's filled with micro capsules that open when you're applying the moisturizer on your face. The tint is just enough to notice there is tint there, but it is not orange nor does it makes me look overly tanned. my skin had a natural Glow after applying. My skin had a natural Glow after applying, and looked lightly sun kissed. I have light wrinkles around my eyes, this moisturizer plumped up my skin, and left the wrinkles less noticeable. the hydration is formula offered my skin was priceless! I appreciate this SPF and I use daily in the morning.

This moisturizer has a nice light scent, non greasy, and has SPF in it. Couldn't ask for much more, however I feel like I need more time to use the product before I give it a full review. After a few weeks of use I haven't noticed much change in my skin. I do love the SPF factor and that alone may be worth it. I did receive this product free in exchange for my honest review from Influenster.

This is a very nice midweight moisturizer. Its tinted and thats probably my only dislike. It melts into your skin well but the tint makes me feel the need to do more blending than I want with a moisturizer. Overall if you're looking for a tinted moisturizer this would be a good choice.

I really enjoy using products from the Perricone brand. I find them to be high quality, and actually deliver results. This tinted moisturizer with SPF was another great product. I love the way it goes on so smoothly,. Or doesn't look like you are wearing makeup, but does help to even out my skin tone.

The tint is a little dark for my skin tone. It has a very strong scent, but easy to apply and it does not dry the skin out. If your are not sensitive to scents, it would be good for you as it's pretty potent. I didn't notice any firming aspects of this.

This tinted moisturizer makes my routine so easy and joyful. The shade blends seamlessly and looks like my skin, just better. It removes effortlessly at night without irritation. The packaging feels elegant and practical, and the instructions are simple and clear. For the value, you get skincare, tint and SPF in one. My skin looks fresh, cared for, and naturally glowing every single day!

This is so lovely. It doesn't pill over my skincare and doesn't cause my makeup base to pill either. It says it's tinted but I don't see any tint. It's very sheer so anyone could use it. It feels moisturizing and looks luminous on the skin. It has a very faint scent that is pleasant. The only thing I would change is to give it a higher SPF.

I love Perricone skincare so I was really excited to try this. It fees a little thick at first but applies very smoothly on my face. I like the size of the pot it comes in and I can really see those pigment capsules spread and transform into a light color tint on my face! I have very fair skin and this applied beautifully and had a very nice and even light coverage. It had no orange hue and had a nice dewy and glowy finish. This is perfect for low maintenance / no makeup days or on the go.

This product goes on smooth but leave a bit of an oiliness behind. The tint is very slight, which doesn't bother me. Packaging is simple and appears high end. My complaint is that my pores clogged. My skin is combination and slightly sensitive.

Nice moisturizer with a slight tint. I love a good tinted moisturizer so I was thrilled to get this and try it. As much as I loved the tint aspect the moisturizer itself wasn't a home run for me. I have dry sensitive skin from living in the desert and this just doesn't have the staying power that I need. Would still recommend this to friends not living in my area, great product, I just needed more is all.

Perricone MD High Potency Face Finishing & Firming Tinted Moisturizer (30 SPF) is a lightweight, fast-absorbing, deeply-hydrating and moisturizing mineral based tinted sunscreen which provides protection from solar and blue-light (from electronics) UV rays. Having melasma and dark spots my dermatologist first and foremost treatment is tinted sunscreen. However, this one provides a dewy natural-looking luminous pearlescence, and illuminating glow unlike other hazy white film tinted sunscreens. It immediately hydrates, and begins repairing with its antioxidants such as: alpha lipoic acid, Bisabolol, which aids in reducing the appearance of lines, wrinkles and increases collagen and elastin production. Before and after shows hand scar that is quite less visible after applying moisturizer. Would recommend 10/10.
This product Makes my skin glow I get more compliments that I look rested truly enjoying it

I was actually rather shocked with this product. I didn't know what to expect. The texture was almost that of a mousse consistency. It looked more like a lip scrub or lotion at first but ended up being light and airy. It blends seamlessly into the skin and leaves a nice, healthy tint. The scent is a little stronger than I prefer for my skincare products but it isn't a deal breaker. I love that my skin is protected while not having a weird white cast or looking extra shiny. This is a really great option for a tinted moisturizer.

This tinted moisturizer is so nice-lightweight but still evens out my skin and gives a natural, smooth finish. It feels comfortable, doesn't build up, and gives a bit of glow while still looking like skin. Great for everyday wear when I want something that feels easy and looks polished.
This tinted moisturizer is great for lazy days where I want to look put together but don't want a full face of makeup. The formula is very nice and doesn't feel sticky or gross on my skin.

I really enjoyed this product. I love tinted moisturizer because I have mature skin and I don't want to have too much coverage and look cakey. The consistency is liked a whipped soufle. It applies easily in a thin layer. Evens out my skin tone and does not pill with other products I use. It has a bit of a fragrance. Smells a little bit like rose petals. It's slight. Not overpowering at all. This is a great product for those no makeup days. I love when a product does double duty and has sunscreen as well

avis.titre: Firming & moisturizing with a subtle glow
avis.texte: Ive become a hige fan of Perricone MD products and the high potency fase finishing and firming tinted moisturizer is no exception. It's absolutely wonderful. I love that its a broad spectrum SPF 30 so it protects my skin from the sun while giving me a light natural tint. The color is not orange or overly brown at all, it blends beautifully and looks natural. It just evens everything out without feeling heavy. Im genuinely very happy with this product and will definitely recommend it. I plan to use it all summer long instead of other spf's. 5 stars!

I'd never tried Perricone MD before and wasn't sure what to expect but man, this stuff is GOOD. It almost looks like a face mask when you open it, and it smells like a DREAM; very clean, luxe, spa vibes. I was a little concerned about the tinted aspect but it just kinda evens your skin tone out in a nice way, gives you a gorgeous glow (but not too intense or greasy looking!), and added SPF is always a bonus, especially living in the south! The consistency looks thick, but you don't need much at all, a small amount is plenty.

avis.titre: Evens skin tone with nice finish
avis.texte: This tinted moisturizer provides lightweight hydration that evens out skin tone. It has a very light tint, but it didn't appear too light as it blended in well. I liked that it also offered SPF 30 protection. I would prefer a heavier moisturizer as my skin runs dry, but overall this is a very nice product.

This Perricone MD high potency face finishing & firming tinted moisturizer is a luxurious cream that absorbs fast into the skin and instantly provides hydration. I wear it alone for a fresh face or under my foundation ŕor a luminous appearance

I can't say enough great things about this product. First, I love that it includes SPF. It does a great job of hydrating my skin. Love that it is tinted as well. It's very subtly tinted and not overpowering.

Loving this finishing moisturizer, been using it over three weeks now and I can see a difference in my face. The feel of this is pure heaven it's so smooth and leaves my face feeling moisturized and healthy all day long. A little does go a long way making it last longer than expected. Love this has a light coverage with an SPF in it as well. Great product no break outs and I have pretty sensitive skin
Very nice fast absorbing cream that blends well with a slight tint. SPF is good for base coverage. Does not leave a residue and very light scent, not overpowering.

Ok wow, this is the lightest weight product I've ever used that has sunscreen in it, I'm blown away! It doesn't smell like sunscreen at all it smells like bergamot and rose. The tint is very slight nothing too crazy! I didn't know I would like it so much! The finished product leaves just a slight sheen, not shiny at all. It makes my skin feel hydrated and soft. Very surprised by this and would highly recommend.

This is really nice. It has a nice light rose scent and applies nicely to the skin. It's not exactly something that would provide coverage but for a no makeup day it's a nice add in. I will continue to use this and I would recommend.

avis.titre: Keep your face moisturized and glowing.
avis.texte: HANDS DOWN, ABSOLUTELY my favorite face finishing and firming tinder moisturizer. When you apply it to your face and as you rub it in, it gives you such a wonderful tanned glow! I love this product and use it everyday. It has a beautiful scent that is not over powering. Helps your face stay hydrated and moisturized. Best part it helps with firming, I'm 40 and I love that aspect of it! Highly recommend Perricone MD and I will definitely purchase once I'm done with my first one!

I love the feeling of this product on my skin. It feels brightening and tightening, yet moisturizing and light. I love the smell though I am not sure what scent it is- not flowery or anything too strong. Blends perfectly! Leaves my skin feeling fresh and I wouldn't even have to layer makeup on top! Perfect for 35+ mom of 2 who doesn't have time to get it together!

I really love this product, it is hydrating and lightweight. Although it was not close to my skin color, I feel it did make my skin look brighter and evened out. It is easy to apply, I would definitely recommend this product. I applied it using my fingers and set it with mineralized powder after. Did not budge for hours. A little goes a long way.

Perricone MD's High Potency Face Finishing & Firming Tinted Moisturizer SPF 30 is an excellent product for my skincare repertoire. The ingredients are anti-aging and wear well. There was no scent. The tint kept the moisturizer from leaving a white cast. It blended well and left a nice sheen. I did not notice any firming effect after several weeks, so I wouldn't put too much hope in that. I took off one star because of the lack of firming. I did wish the SPF could have been 50, though. I love that the bottle is solid in my hands. Highly recommended!!!

avis.titre: Great moisturizer but not impressed by the tint
avis.texte: Thank you to Influenster for sending me the Perricone MD High Potency Classics Face Finishing & Firming Tinted Moisturizer Broad Spectrum SPF 30. This product effectively simplifies a morning routine by combining moisturizer, foundation and sunscreen. The formula is lightweight, fast-absorbing, and easy to blend. It feels smooth and soft on the skin while offering great oil control with a non-greasy, "second skin" finish. As a moisturizer, it performs very well. However, I was less impressed with the tint. While I noticed a slight blurring effect in my before-and-after photos, the coverage was minimal. I understand that tinted moisturizers are meant to provide a natural look, but I personally prefer a stronger tint. While the formula is lightweight enough to build up with foundation, doing so defeats the purpose of using a tinted product. I believe this moisturizer would work best for individuals with very pale skin or those with an even complexion who prefer an exceptionally natural finish.
Yes Yes Yes! The texture of this moisturizer is A1! The color is perfect. You can definitely see results after the first week of consistently use. I applied daily and saw fine lines fade.

I received this product free from Influenster in exchange for my honest review. This moisturizer has quickly become one of my favorite products. The texture is lightweight and absorbs fast and blends seamlessly into my skin, giving it a natural healthy glow. The tint is very subtle but does a great job job evening out my complexion, making it perfect for no makeup days. I love that it hydrates well and provides SPF. My skin looks smoother and hydrated, and it's beautiful under a makeup and doesn't pill. It serves as skincare and makeup. I'm so happy with the results that I will keep using this product.
